ctbids-48804-5695082.description:
Discover a distinguished selection of vintage sterling silver jewelry, featuring hand-crafted studio artisan designs, iconic mid-century modernist gems, and earthy bohemian statement pieces.
- Each item boasts individual character, genuine gemstone settings, and exquisite craft detailing. All pieces are in good condition.
-Mid-Century Modernist "Mast" Malachite Pendant A stunning geometric minimalist pendant crafted in the mid-century Scandinavian style.
- The architectural open-back sterling silver frame holds a vibrant green "bullseye" malachite cabochon featuring crisp, concentric banding. It measures 2.5 inches long by 1.75 inches wide at the base and bears a clean "925" hallmark.
-Linda Lusche Variscite & Quartz Pin-Pendant An artisan studio piece designed as a dual-function brooch and pendant combination. Hand-signed by maker Linda Lusche, the sterling silver body features a lime-green spiderweb variscite top stone anchored by a sleek, hanging quartz crystal point encased in a silver sleeve.
-Note: The lower crystal end exhibits visible silver-plating wear/peeling on the cap setting. Measures 2.5 inches long by 1.5 inches wide.
- Aluma U.S.A. Caged Amber Necklace An earthy, bohemian-style artisan wire-wrapped pendant holding a natural cognac-honey amber gemstone nestled within a woven sterling silver nest.
-Paired with a solid 28-inch Italian sterling silver snake chain, the teardrop pendant exhibits excellent clarity with warm golden internal inclusions and measures 2 by 1.5 inches. Fully stamped "AIL 925" on the pendant and "Italy 925" on the chain.
- Southwestern Lime Turquoise Pendant Necklace A bold Southwestern statement piece showcasing an intense chartreuse/neon-green turquoise cabochon with a rich golden-brown matrix set in .925 sterling silver.
-The oval pendant features an ornate baluster-style bail and comes paired with a heavy-textured vintage silver-plated round box chain finished with the signature crown tag from Premier Designs.
-Vintage Reversible Dual-Sided Agate Pendant A classical vertical rectangular pendant offering two distinct looks in one. One side features a deep green chalcedony/jade-style cabochon; flipping the piece reveals a rich red carnelian agate on the reverse. Topped with an ornate, openwork silver filigree bail. Stamped 925; measures 1.75 inches long by 0.75 inches wide.

280373844.description: This lot includes approximately 4.9 pounds of mixed mineral and gemstone specimens. The collection features three groups: rough natural stones in various shapes and colors; a pile of small tumbled and polished gemstone chips in clear, black, yellow, purple, blue, and pink hues; and a selection of medium to large tumbled and polished stones in assorted colors such as green, black, red, and blue. The stones consist of semi-precious minerals including quartz, amethyst, jasper, agate, and potentially others. The condition varies from raw, uncut mineral chunks to smooth, polished stones. No specific brand or manufacturer is associated. Suitable for collectors, crafters, or educational use.

280120855.description:
Natural Quartz Geode
Crystal Cluster Specimen, Tan Matrix
Vintage, Approximately 4 Inches
This natural quartz geode features a hollow interior lined with sparkling clear to white crystal points. The specimen is housed within a textured, tan-colored rocky matrix that provides a beautiful contrast to the crystalline core. Geodes of this type are formed through mineral deposition within rock cavities, making each piece a unique geological treasure for collectors.
Interior cavity filled with clear quartz crystal druzy and small points
Rough, natural tan stone exterior matrix with authentic texture
Single piece specimen with flat display potential
Measurements: 4 inches L x 3 inches W x 2.5 inches H
Condition:
Natural condition with no damage to the crystal interior. The exterior matrix shows natural variations and textures inherent to raw stone specimens. No artificial coloring or treatments observed. Structurally sound for display.
